parameters.name: BlackList
parameters.description: The list of IP addresses or address segments to add to the blacklist. You can add up to 200 IP addresses or address segments.

parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description:
The domain name of the website.

> A website forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. Call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group in Resource Management to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance is added to the default resource group.

parameters.name: WhiteList
parameters.description: The IP addresses or CIDR blocks for the whitelist. You can add up to 200 IP addresses or CIDR blocks.
